cause_quote: The new disabled-corpus response said, 'Enable memory.search.experimental.sessionMemory and add "sessions" to memory.search.sources, then retry memory_search,' making a configuration change the only recovery it offered.
user_saw: With semantic session indexing disabled, users could be told to enable it even when the agent could look up the transcript through session history.
summary: The fix explains when the semantic sessions corpus is unavailable and makes the recovery advice conditional on the session-history capabilities available for the run.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff and confirmed that the explicit disabled-corpus response shipped with configuration-only recovery advice. The later sanitized-history prompt already checked tool availability, and the unconditional sessions_search advice described in the PR reproduction is absent from the merged parent’s tool description and disabled-corpus response. The classification follows the guidance defect in the merged diff.
